title: Compliance checks: prohibition of promotion of certain tax avoidance schemes — CC/FS91
text:
Factsheets are for guidance only and reflect HMRC’s position at the time of writing.

 This factsheet gives information about:

 • the prohibition of promotion of certain tax avoidance ( POP )

 • what we mean by ‘promote’ and ‘arrangements’

 • civil and criminal penalties

 • your rights if we’re considering penalties

 • what to do if you disagree with a penalty decision

 • how to get help and support
